producerKind.title: Agent
producerKind.description: A model-backed review agent produced the result.

producerKind.title: Deterministic sensor
producerKind.description: A deterministic tool or sensor produced the result.

producerKind.title: Human
producerKind.description: A human reviewer produced the result.

producerKind.title: Imported
producerKind.description: An adapter imported the result from another durable contract.

producerKind.title: Unknown
producerKind.description: The available evidence does not establish the producer kind.

evidenceStatus.title: Available
evidenceStatus.description: The expected evidence is available for assessment.

evidenceStatus.title: Partial
evidenceStatus.description: Some expected evidence is unavailable or incomplete.

assessment.title: Pass
assessment.description: The evidence establishes conformance for the assessed subject.

assessment.title: Concern
assessment.description: The evidence establishes a material concern without establishing failure.

assessment.title: Fail
assessment.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance for the assessed subject.

assessment.title: Inconclusive
assessment.description: The available evidence cannot establish conformance or non-conformance.

assessment.title: Not applicable
assessment.description: The assessment does not apply to this subject.

assessment.title: Not assessed
assessment.description: No assessment has yet been performed.

change.title: Mixed
change.description: The comparison contains both improvements and regressions.

change.title: Unchanged
change.description: The comparison establishes no meaningful change.

change.title: No observed delta
change.description: The comparison observed no quality delta.

change.title: Inconclusive
change.description: The evidence cannot establish the direction of change.

decision.title: Allow
decision.description: The referenced policy permits the subject or action.

decision.title: Warn
decision.description: The referenced policy permits the subject or action with a warning.

decision.title: Block
decision.description: The referenced policy blocks the subject or action.

decision.title: Defer
decision.description: The referenced policy defers a decision until more evidence is available.

severity.title: Critical
severity.description: Immediate action is required because impact is systemic or catastrophic.

severity.title: High
severity.description: Prompt action is required because impact is substantial.

severity.title: Medium
severity.description: The issue has meaningful impact and should be planned for correction.

severity.title: Low
severity.description: The issue has limited impact and should be corrected when practical.

severity.title: Info
severity.description: The item is informational and does not by itself require correction.

lifecycle.title: Open
lifecycle.description: The issue currently requires disposition or remediation.

lifecycle.title: Accepted risk
lifecycle.description: An authorized actor accepted the issue's risk.

lifecycle.title: Waived
lifecycle.description: An authorized actor temporarily waived the issue under stated conditions.

lifecycle.title: False positive
lifecycle.description: An authorized actor determined that the reported issue is not present or applicable.

lifecycle.title: Resolved
lifecycle.description: Evidence under a reconciliation policy establishes that the issue is resolved.

evidenceKind.title: Source code
evidenceKind.description: Source code or a source location supports the result.

evidenceKind.title: Test result
evidenceKind.description: A test execution result supports the result.

evidenceKind.title: Runtime measurement
evidenceKind.description: A runtime measurement supports the result.

evidenceKind.title: Tool result
evidenceKind.description: Structured or textual output from a tool supports the result.

evidenceKind.title: Artifact
evidenceKind.description: A durable artifact supports the result.

evidenceKind.title: Human attestation
evidenceKind.description: A human attestation supports the result.

aspects.title: Correctness
aspects.description: Behavior is correct for the documented and inferred contract.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Code structure and dependencies preserve the intended architecture.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: The subject preserves confidentiality, integrity, availability, and intended authority.

aspects.title: Secrets
aspects.description: Secrets are not exposed and are handled through appropriate controls.

aspects.title: Dependencies
aspects.description: Dependencies do not introduce unaddressed security risk.

aspects.title: Authentication and authorization
aspects.description: Identity and authority are established and enforced at every relevant boundary.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Untrusted input is validated and safely handled at its trust boundary.

aspects.title: Configuration and infrastructure as code
aspects.description: Security-relevant configuration and infrastructure definitions enforce intended controls.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Externally reachable and cross-trust boundaries have explicit, proportionate controls.

aspects.title: Business logic
aspects.description: Security-sensitive business workflows resist abuse across their complete flow.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Applicable attack classes have current and sufficient assessment evidence.

aspects.title: Performance
aspects.description: The subject uses resources proportionately and meets relevant performance expectations.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: The change introduces a proportionate and understood level of risk.

aspects.title: Test evidence
aspects.description: The change has test evidence proportionate to its behavioral risk.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: The change remains within its stated scope and avoids unrelated churn.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: The change preserves or intentionally evolves established architectural boundaries.
